svg.text: Smart Attendance & Geofencing — Firestore Data Model

All 16 collections as written by the code. Timestamps are stored in UTC; tzOffsetMinutes exists only so clients can render local time. PK = document id. Every foreign key is annotated inline as FK field -> collection; lines are drawn only for the structural spine, because Firestore has no joins and 12 crossing arrows read worse than the annotations do.
